summary.text: Modern Horizons 3 follows Meren of Clan Nel Toth, who is forced to drink the Dreamfire Draught and face an elemental, which she destroys with necromancy, and the elders then deem her dangerous and she leaves for Grixis.
Trained in Grixis, Meren reanimates a great dragon, Skaal Kesh, attacks her old home, and duels Kael, whom the dragon devours, and she resolves to topple Jund.
Elsewhere, Emrakul arrives on Innistrad and even fossils answer her twisted call.
